notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.1 - Poll: F6 writes only checked or edited rows; out-of-range values are refused; late TCP replies no longer desync polling; reconnects after the slave restarts; No response warning in the status bar; Stop / Auto Poll and device switching fixed. Slave: Listen no longer rewrites other devices; values are saved in projects; FC07/FC08 and bad quantities answered at once; RTU frame gap 3.5 chars. Linux: AppImage runs without libopengl0.
